observations.body: Hosea’s children receive names announcing an end to Jehu’s house, no mercy, and not my people.
observations.label: Children bear names of judgment and future reunion: action

observations.body: the oracle then speaks of innumerable children, restored peoplehood, and Judah and Israel gathered under one head.

payload.posture: Read Hosea 1:2–11 as prophets accuse and promise evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The reversal is promised beside judgment without explaining how the divided houses pass from rejected names to reunion.
